reading: The latest Russian unmanned aerial vehicle attack on Kyiv's Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge coincided with a surprise visit from German Chancellor Friedrich Merz to the Ukrainian capital.

Video footage, independently verified, captured the moment an unmanned aerial vehicle crashed into the Pivnichyi Bridge as traffic moved across it, resulting in a large conflagration and a rising cloud of black smoke.
This attack marked the fourth successive day that major bridges in Kyiv have been targeted by Russian aerial assaults, as Moscow ramps up attacks on critical infrastructure in Ukraine's capital.

Two individuals sustained non-fatal injuries when the Pivnichyi Bridge was struck for the second day in a row, with the Pivdennyi (Southern) Bridge also having been targeted multiple times earlier in the week.
Other social media content showed a gaping hole in the middle of a traffic lane on the bridge, evidencing significant structural damage.

Kyiv's eight bridges spanning the Dnipro River are essential arteries, linking the city's eastern and western sectors, with many of the capital's estimated three million inhabitants relying heavily on public transport and personal vehicles for daily transit.
Although the two targeted bridges remain structurally sound, the damage and subsequent traffic restrictions have at times led to widespread gridlock across parts of the capital.
A Kyiv resident conveyed the severity of the travel disruption, stating, "'To get from the left bank to the right one and back - it's just hell.'"

Repair teams are actively addressing the damage, and officials are exploring contingency measures like temporary pontoon bridges, ferry services, and even a river tunnel to ensure Kyiv remains connected.
Beyond the bridge attacks, other Russian aerial bombardments on Sunday damaged a heating main, causing a temporary hot water shortage in the Desnyanskyi district.
Additionally, Russian drones struck a warehouse in Sumy, claiming one life, as reported by President Zelensky.
Ukraine's Air Force reported that out of 135 unmanned aerial vehicles launched overnight by Russia, including 52 jet-powered variants, 125 projectiles were successfully intercepted.
As emergency services responded, German Chancellor Merz met President Zelensky in Kyiv, and they laid wreaths for Ukrainian soldiers killed in the war.
Merz reaffirmed Germany's support for Ukraine, stating, "'Ukraine is facing decisive weeks. That is why I travelled to Kyiv today with the message: You can rely on us.'"
Merz underscored Germany's position, asserting, "'Germany's security also depends on the outcome of this war. That is why we are helping out of our own self-interest as well.'"
Since Merz assumed the chancellorship in May 2025, Germany has become Ukraine's single largest financial benefactor.

President Zelensky has consistently appealed to Western allies for more sophisticated military assistance, specifically requesting advanced interceptors capable of shooting down newer jet-powered Russian unmanned aerial vehicles and ballistic missiles.
Russia's defense ministry declared its intention to intensify its campaign across Ukraine, framing it as a response to Zelensky's earlier remarks about escalating attacks on Russian oil refineries.
The Russian foreign ministry reiterated a warning for foreign citizens, including diplomats, to leave Kyiv.

Responding to this warning, EU ambassador Katarína Mathernová declared, "'The EU Delegation is staying. Threatening us will not stop Europe's support for Ukraine. It only reminds us why that support matters!'"
German ambassador to Ukraine, Boris Ruge, echoed this sentiment, stating, "'Amen - we're staying'."

Experts assess that while Russian aerial assaults are unlikely to demolish the bridges outright, sustained targeting risks forcing their closure and weakening their structural integrity, ultimately rendering them unusable.

vocabulary.definition: Increases the amount or intensity of something; makes something more active.
A large, extensive, and destructive fire.
A very large, wide-open hole, often implying significant damage or emptiness.
Depending significantly or predominantly on something or someone.
A situation where a network of roads becomes so congested with traffic that all movement stops.
Plans or actions taken to prepare for possible future events or problems.
Stated again in a definite way; confirmed a previous commitment or belief.
Concern for one's own advantage and well-being.
A person or organization that gives money or other help to a person or cause, often financial.
Aircraft or missiles designed to detect and destroy enemy aircraft or missiles.
Missiles that follow a trajectory governed by gravity, typically unpowered after launch and guided only during the initial phase.
Said again or repeated, often for emphasis or clarity.

entries.ja: 何かの量や強度を増やすこと、または何かをより活発にすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 양이나 강도를 늘리거나, 어떤 것을 더 활발하게 만드는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 增加某物的数量或强度；使某物更加活跃。
entries.es: Aumentar la cantidad o intensidad de algo; hacer que algo sea más activo.
entries.pt-BR: Aumenta a quantidade ou intensidade de algo; torna algo mais ativo.
entries.fr: Augmenter la quantité ou l'intensité de quelque chose ; rendre quelque chose plus actif.
entries.de: Die Menge oder Intensität von etwas erhöhen; etwas aktiver machen.

entries.ja: 大規模で広範囲にわたる破壊的な火災。
entries.zh-Hans: 一场大规模的、范围广阔的、具有破坏性的火灾。
entries.es: Un incendio grande, extenso y destructivo.
entries.pt-BR: Um incêndio grande, extenso e destrutivo.
entries.fr: Un grand incendie étendu et destructeur.
entries.de: Ein großes, ausgedehntes und zerstörerisches Feuer.

entries.ja: 非常に大きく口を開けた穴で、しばしば甚大な損傷や空虚さを意味する。
entries.ko: 매우 크고 넓게 벌어진 구멍으로, 종종 상당한 손상이나 텅 비어 있음을 암시한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个非常大的、敞开的洞，通常暗示着严重的损坏或空虚。
entries.es: Un agujero muy grande y abierto, que a menudo implica un daño o un vacío significativo.
entries.pt-BR: Um buraco muito grande e aberto, frequentemente indicando dano significativo ou vazio.
entries.fr: Un trou très grand et béant, impliquant souvent des dégâts importants ou un vide.
entries.de: Ein sehr großes, weit geöffnetes Loch, das oft erhebliche Schäden oder Leere impliziert.

entries.ja: 何かや誰かに大きく、または主に依存していること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이나 누군가에게 크게 또는 주로 의존하고 있는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在很大程度上或主要依赖某事或某人。
entries.es: Depender de manera significativa o predominante de algo o alguien.
entries.pt-BR: Depender significativamente ou predominantemente de algo ou alguém.
entries.fr: Dépendre de manière significative ou prédominante de quelque chose ou de quelqu'un.
entries.de: Erheblich oder überwiegend auf etwas oder jemanden angewiesen sein.

entries.ja: 道路網が交通でひどく混雑し、すべての移動が停止する状況。
entries.ko: 도로망이 교통으로 인해 매우 혼잡해져 모든 움직임이 멈추는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 指道路交通网络因过于拥堵而导致所有车辆停止移动的情况。
entries.es: Una situación en la que una red de carreteras se congestiona tanto con el tráfico que todo movimiento se detiene.
entries.pt-BR: Uma situação onde uma rede de estradas fica tão congestionada com tráfego que todo movimento para.
entries.fr: Une situation où un réseau routier devient si encombré par le trafic que tout mouvement s'arrête.
entries.de: Eine Situation, in der ein Straßennetz so stark durch Verkehr überlastet ist, dass jegliche Bewegung zum Erliegen kommt.

entries.ja: 起こりうる将来の出来事や問題に備えて講じられる計画や行動。
entries.ko: 가능한 미래의 사건이나 문제에 대비하여 취해지는 계획이나 조치.
entries.zh-Hans: 为应对可能发生的未来事件或问题而采取的计划或行动。
entries.es: Planes o acciones tomadas para prepararse ante posibles eventos o problemas futuros.
entries.pt-BR: Planos ou ações tomadas para preparar-se para possíveis eventos ou problemas futuros.
entries.fr: Des plans ou des actions mis en œuvre pour se préparer à d'éventuels événements ou problèmes futurs.
entries.de: Pläne oder Maßnahmen, die zur Vorbereitung auf mögliche zukünftige Ereignisse oder Probleme getroffen werden.

entries.ja: 断定的な方法で再び述べること。以前の約束や信念を再確認すること。
entries.ko: 확고한 방식으로 다시 진술하는 것; 이전의 약속이나 신념을 재확인하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 以明确的方式再次声明；确认之前的承诺或信念。
entries.es: Declarar algo de nuevo de manera definida; confirmar un compromiso o creencia anterior.
entries.pt-BR: Declarar novamente de forma definida; confirmar um compromisso ou crença anterior.
entries.fr: Affirmer de nouveau de manière catégorique ; confirmer un engagement ou une conviction antérieure.
entries.de: Etwas erneut auf eine bestimmte Art und Weise feststellen; eine frühere Zusage oder Überzeugung bestätigen.

entries.ja: 自分自身の利益と幸福への関心。
entries.es: Preocupación por la propia ventaja y bienestar.
entries.pt-BR: Preocupação com a própria vantagem e bem-estar.
entries.fr: Le souci de son propre avantage et bien-être.
entries.de: Sorge um den eigenen Vorteil und das Wohlergehen.

entries.ja: 個人や団体に、しばしば金銭的な援助を与える人や組織。
entries.ko: 개인이나 대의명분에 돈이나 다른 도움을 주는 사람이나 조직으로, 주로 재정적인 도움을 제공한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 向个人或事业提供金钱或其他帮助的人或组织，通常是财务上的帮助。
entries.es: Una persona u organización que da dinero u otra ayuda a una persona o causa, a menudo financiera.
entries.pt-BR: Uma pessoa ou organização que dá dinheiro ou outra ajuda a uma pessoa ou causa, frequentemente financeira.
entries.fr: Une personne ou une organisation qui donne de l'argent ou d'autres formes d'aide à une personne ou à une cause, souvent financière.
entries.de: Eine Person oder Organisation, die einer Person oder Sache Geld oder andere Hilfe zukommen lässt, oft finanzieller Art.

entries.ja: 敵の航空機やミサイルを探知し破壊するように設計された航空機またはミサイル。
entries.ko: 적의 항공기나 미사일을 탐지하고 파괴하도록 설계된 항공기나 미사일.
entries.zh-Hans: 旨在探测并摧毁敌方飞机或导弹的飞行器或导弹。
entries.es: Aeronaves o misiles diseñados para detectar y destruir aeronaves o misiles enemigos.
entries.pt-BR: Aeronaves ou mísseis projetados para detectar e destruir aeronaves ou mísseis inimigos.
entries.fr: Avions ou missiles conçus pour détecter et détruire les avions ou missiles ennemis.
entries.de: Flugzeuge oder Raketen, die dazu bestimmt sind, feindliche Flugzeuge oder Raketen zu entdecken und zu zerstören.

entries.ja: 重力によって軌道が決定されるミサイルで、通常は発射後に推進されず、初期段階のみ誘導される。
entries.ko: 발사 후에는 일반적으로 추진되지 않고 중력에 의해 궤적이 결정되며, 초기 단계에서만 유도되는 미사일.
entries.zh-Hans: 指遵循重力轨迹的导弹，通常在发射后无动力，仅在初始阶段进行制导。
entries.es: Misiles que siguen una trayectoria regida por la gravedad, típicamente sin propulsión después del lanzamiento y guiados solo durante la fase inicial.
entries.pt-BR: Mísseis que seguem uma trajetória governada pela gravidade, tipicamente sem propulsão após o lançamento e guiados apenas durante a fase inicial.
entries.fr: Missiles qui suivent une trajectoire régie par la gravité, généralement sans propulsion après le lancement et guidés uniquement pendant la phase initiale.
entries.de: Raketen, die einer von der Schwerkraft bestimmten Flugbahn folgen, typischerweise nach dem Start unbemannt sind und nur in der Anfangsphase gelenkt werden.

entries.ja: 強調や明確さのために、再度述べたり繰り返したりすること。
entries.ko: 강조하거나 명확하게 하기 위해 다시 말하거나 반복하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 再次陈述或重复，通常是为了强调或使内容更清晰。
entries.es: Decir de nuevo o repetir, a menudo para enfatizar o clarificar.
entries.pt-BR: Dizer novamente ou repetir, frequentemente para dar ênfase ou clareza.
entries.fr: Dire à nouveau ou répéter, souvent pour insister ou clarifier.
entries.de: Etwas erneut sagen oder wiederholen, oft zur Betonung oder Klarheit.
